about: Opt-in routing selects the declared default command only when the root reaches the successful end of argv without consuming a positional argument or a syntactic separator.

vectors.doc: An explicitly enabled empty invocation enters the default command.
Parent and global flags are still owned by the root while an otherwise empty invocation selects its default.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
flag "--verbose" global=#true
cmd "run"

vectors.doc: An unmatched ordinary word retains the pre-existing default-word route; on-empty does not change that behavior.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
cmd "run" {
  arg "[task]"
}

vectors.doc: A syntactic separator suppresses implicit selection even when no positional follows it.
A flag that accepts hyphenated values consumes a literal separator as its value; this is not a syntactic separator and the default is selected.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
flag "--value <value>" allow_hyphen_values=#true
cmd "run"

vectors.doc: A missing parent flag value is a parse error rather than an empty invocation.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
flag "--value <value>"
cmd "run"

vectors.doc: Child environment values are applied after implicit selection.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
cmd "run" {
  flag "--profile <profile>" env="EX_PROFILE"
}

vectors.doc: Child defaults are applied after implicit selection.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
cmd "run" {
  flag "--profile <profile>" default="local"
}

vectors.doc: Implicit child selection does not waive required root arguments when negation is disabled.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
arg "<root>"
cmd "run"

vectors.doc: A child selected with subcommand_negates_reqs waives the root requirement.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
subcommand_negates_reqs #true
arg "<root>"
cmd "run"

vectors.doc: Explicit selection retains the same root requirement policy.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
arg "<root>"
cmd "run"

vectors.doc: An explicit alias selects the child normally.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
cmd "run" { alias "r" }

vectors.doc: An unknown flag error wins before implicit selection.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
default_subcommand "run"
default_subcommand_on_empty #true
unknown_flags "error"
cmd "run"

vectors.doc: The option is disabled by default.
